description: To replace extant planning permission 01380/A/P5 for the erection of a new office and warehouse building following demolition of existing buildings
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2830/PL01RevB, (Location &Block Plan), PL.02RevA, (Site Plan), 2830/PL.03, (front elevation), 2830/PL.04 (Proposed
Ground Floor Plan), 2830/PL.05 (First Floor Plan), 2830/PL06 (Roof Plan), 2830/PL.07 (Cross Section front elevationSheet1), 2830/PL.08 (Rear elevation &side elevation sheet 2) 2830/PL.09 (Side elev. North - West), PL.10 (Existing Office floor PlanPL.11 (Existing First Floor Ancillary, Residential Accommodation) PL.12 (Existing Front &Side Elevations), PL.13 (Existing Rear & Side Elevations), 2830/PL.14 (warehouse existing Plan), PL.15 (Existing warehouse front& Side Elevations), Existing Rear &Side warehouse Elevations) PL.23 (Existing & Proposed Cross  Section), PL.24 (Bin & Cycle store) and Design and Access Statement)   therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
Condition : 5 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Before commencement of operations, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:
(i)	any external illumination of the site
(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and
(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.
The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.
Condition : 7 - Storage or other approved activities shall not take place anywhere on the site except within buildings hereby approved.

Condition : 8 - The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises and shall not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 9 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 10 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before the use hereby permitted is commenced or in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 11 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out and maintained as approved.  

Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme)

Condition : 12 - A landscape management plan, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for all hard and soft landscape areas shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority prior to the occupation of the development or any phase of the development, whichever is the sooner, for its permitted use.  The landscape management plan shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 13 - No development shall take place until details of a Sustainable Drainage Scheme, including measures for harvesting of rainwater, the minimisation of water run-off from the site, aiming for greenfield levels, and the conservation and reuse as appropriate of other water supplies in the building have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The building shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 14 - No development shall take place until a statement on the sourcing of materials to be used in the building, involving reuse, recycling and other sustainable sourcing of materials to be used in the construction of extensions and fitting out of the building wherever possible, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 15 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the approved plans and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 16 - Before the development hereby permitted commences on the site an investigation shall be carried out to identify the extent of contamination and the results provided to the Local Planning Authority.  The investigation will be carried out at such points and to such depth as the Local Planning Authority may stipulate.  A scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Authority in writing and the scheme as approved shall be fully implemented and completed before any development hereby permitted is first occupied.

Condition : 17 - The developer shall submit to the council a plan of highway works showing a reduction in length of the central reservation in Dick Turpin Way to the south of the site access road junction and an increase in the radius to 10.0metres of the kerbline of the southern corner of the junction of the site access road with Dick Turpin Way. 
Such details shall be submitted and approved in writing and the works completed prior to the occupation of the site.

Condition : 18 - No development shall take place until an energy assessment has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority which demonstrates how the hierarchy of energy efficiency, efficiency supply of energy and renewable energy generation has been observed. The assessment should show that a reduction in CO2 emissions of at least 20% from the use of renewable energy technologies will be achieved, taken from a CO2 emissions baseline as calculated after the application of energy efficiency and efficient supply measures. Full details of the proposed energy efficiency measures and renewable energy technology(ies) should be submitted as part of the application.

The building shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details
